title: Iran denounces U.S. use of AI in war
summary: Iran's U.N. envoy claims the U.S. military used Palantir and Anthropic AI systems to select some 2,000 targets over just four days.

title: Andy Taylor, longtime Duran Duran guitarist, dies at 65
summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, has died at age 65 following a battle with prostate cancer.

title: At least 31 killed after fuel tanker crashes and catches fire near Cairo
summary: A crash involving a fuel tanker has ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo, killing at least 31 people.

title: Army detonates toxic explosives at Iowa plant despite concerns
summary: The U.S. Army detonated a stockpile of degrading explosives at a munitions plant in Iowa on Wednesday, after days of back-and-forth between politicians and the courts.

title: Judge declines to issue long-term ban on tax-funded pro-Trump ads
summary: A federal judge has sided against Democrats on the federal government's taxpayer-funded political ads, which critics say were illegal propaganda intended to promote President Trump.

title: Judge temporarily blocks FCC from reviewing ABC's licenses
summary: A federal judge blocked the FCC from moving forward with an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses, a move the network argues is an attempt by the Trump administration to punish speech it does not like.

title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed for 1st time in history
summary: For the first time in history, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed due to weather, Macy's said Wednesday.

title: Maps show where Thanksgiving storms could disrupt holiday
summary: Rain, snow and powerful winds were forecast to impact large stretches of the country on Thanksgiving, potentially disrupting holiday festivities and, in some areas, hampering travel plans.

title: A look at the probes involving Nvidia, Jensen Huang and Megaspeed
summary: The reinstatement of Jensen Huang as president and CEO of Nvidia sent shockwaves through the political and business world, and has fueled scrutiny by Congress.

title: Trump owned millions in Nvidia stock as he pressed for Jensen Huang's reinstatement
summary: President Trump holds tens of millions in Nvidia shares, giving him a personal stake in the company's stock market roller coaster ride of the past two weeks, financial disclosure documents show.

title: Butterball Turkey hotline ramps up staffing, prepared to help with Thanksgiving cooking needs
summary: Even in the world of email, texting and artificial intelligence, the Butterball Turkey hotline has only gotten more popular. The larger team is prepared to field about 100,000 calls this holiday season to help with any turkey troubles. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

title: Details on why Macy's postponed its Thanksgiving Day Parade
summary: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, watched by tens of millions of people, including those lining the streets of New York, has been postponed because of weather for the first time ever. Organizers made the announcement Wednesday, just hours after inflating those infamous balloons. Tom Hanson reports and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

title: EPA detects no lead in air shortly after toxic Iowa chemical detonation
summary: The Army went through with blowing up five tons of an old bomb-making chemical at a plant in Iowa on Wednesday, hoping to control the potential for a cloud of lead dust. Ian Lee reports.

title: Food banks see surge in visits amid rising Thanksgiving costs
summary: Some food banks are having to restock supplies as more families look for assistance ahead of this year's Thanksgiving festivities. CBS News' Jason Allen reports.

title: How people are using AI to cancel subscriptions, claim refunds
summary: People are using AI agents to handle tedious tasks that could save them money. CBS News' Megan Cerullo explains.

title: Jennifer Lopez's choreographer on what to expect from "The JLo Show"
summary: Kiel Tutin, supervising choreographer for "The JLo Show," joins "The Daily Report" to discuss the film and Jennifer Lopez's intense Las Vegas residency. "The JLo Show" premieres Thursday night on CBS and Paramount+. Paramount+ is owned by CBS News' parent company, Skydance.

title: King tides cause monster waves, flooding on California coastline
summary: Tuesday night's full moon supercharged king tides in the West, causing flooding in several of California's coastal communities. Matt Gutman reports.

title: Steelers release Aaron Rodgers after tirade following benching
summary: Quarterback Aaron Rodgers, a four-time NFL MVP, was benched by the Pittsburgh Steelers and then cut hours after an interview in which he accused head coach Mike McCarthy of sleeping through meetings. Mark Strassmann has more details.

title: Thanksgiving holiday travel chaos in full swing amid stormy weather
summary: A "passenger disturbance" prompted a Chicago-bound flight to divert to Phoenix on Wednesday, federal officials said. Meanwhile, Thanksgiving travelers crowded airports and some raced against Mother Nature as a storm moves up the East Coast. Kris Van Cleave reports.

title: As Thanksgiving meal costs rise, food donation lines get longer
summary: At the home of the Dallas Cowboys, thousands of cars inched across the massive parking lot as volunteers filled truck beds with turkeys, potatoes, cabbage and carrots. The cost of a Thanksgiving meal is even more expensive this year, creating more demand from families in need. Jason Allen has more.

title: Thieves steal cufflinks, clock from British royal estate
summary: Two Albanian men were accused of breaking into the country home of Prince William and Princess Kate. Holly Williams reports.

title: Trump blames volatile stock market on midterm election results
summary: President Trump blamed the volatile stock market on the midterm election results that will put Democrats in control of Congress in January. Weijia Jiang has more.

title: Trump owned millions in Nvidia stock while pushing for Jensen Huang's reinstatement
summary: Financial disclosures reveal that President Trump holds tens of millions of dollars worth of Nvidia shares, giving him a personal stake in the company's recent roller coster ride in the stock market. CBS News' Isabel Vincent has more.

title: Videos show California flooding, damage from king tides
summary: King tides and monster waves hit coastal communities in California this week. Videos show the flooding, damage and mitigation efforts.
